notes.title: Side Stories EP01
notes.content:
A new update is ready, with 2 new side stories in Episode 01

1. Cindy and Lloyd
2. Nadine and Justin

Nadine and Justin has a male narrator as 1st POV.
I'm working on a new update that will have a female voice as a narrator and two additional voices for Justin and Nadine.
Minor audio effects (door closing ,steps, little moans, etc.) will be ready with the next update.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Future Updates AUG / SEP
notes.content:
With the next update, included in DLC2, but set in episode 1, two new side stories, with voice over, sound effects, music and ambience sounds, in 4K resolution will be released.

The game is open now also for curators, please apply, contact me, in case of interest.
Thank you

notes.title: DLC 2 and general Updates
notes.content:
DLC 2 - Beach Party is here. Enjoy music, sounds, voice over, sensual moans and the lovely Cindy and sexy Michelle.

The camera can be selected either (close or far, left or right), I hope this will make the replay of the game more exciting.

Next update (included in DLC2) - late AUG or late SEP:
[list]
[*] Cindy and Blonde Guy different path for EP1
[*] Big optional side story of buy and girl, also in EP1
[*] Almost all scenes have 2 camera choices, still thinking if I can skip the expensive voice over(?)
[/list]
